summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K containing earnings coverage ratios on subordinated indebtedness and preferred shares for the twelve months ended April 30, 2026. The filing reports a grossed-up dividend coverage of 18.85x, interest coverage of 39.97x, and combined coverage of 13.03x. This is a routine financial disclosure required under Canadian securities regulations, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is purely informational and does not trigger any event-driven analysis or risk-arbitrage angle.
